integrity: The all-prime result is established by coefficient recurrences and valuation arguments. Small-field exhaustive tests are corroboration only. Earlier construction and structural theorems are credited.
scientific_limitations: All values are for labeled parameter polynomials and embedded one-dimensional subalgebras; no higher-dimensional subalgebra classification, isomorphism-class spectrum or independent validation. Some older idempotent literature could not be inspected in full.
title: Joint spectra of lines and idempotents in modular differential Novikov algebras
